name: search_procedures
description: Search every analyzed procedure name using literal matching by default or regex when requested. Results are deterministic and complete. Hopper regex mode uses ECMAScript Unicode syntax in a cancellable worker. The matching deadline is REA_REGEX_MATCHING_DEADLINE_MS (a positive decimal integer of milliseconds from 1 to 2147483647, default 5000). Unset keeps the default. A deadline failure names the effective milliseconds, source (default or setting), the default, and the maximum, and leaves the API usable. The worker old-generation request is REA_REGEX_WORKER_HEAP_REQUEST_MIB (a decimal integer of mebibytes from 7 to 16384, default 128). Unset keeps the default. A positive Node --max-old-space-size, including NODE_OPTIONS, overrides that request and is not limited by the setting's floor or maximum. A heap failure names the effective request, its source (default or setting), the default, the floor, and the maximum. Select detail summary for counts and retained native-inventory pages; complete remains the default.
